findings: Honors no-over-scaffolding: 9-crate plan → 3 value types into existing domain. AuthzRequest/AuthzDecision are the foundational Cedar evaluation contract types every downstream policy surface (engine adapter, gRPC boundary) will serialize through. Minimal surface area, no framework imports beyond serde.

BTreeMap for context provides deterministic serialization order at any scale. Pure value types with no internal state are trivially shareable across shards. serde round-trip is allocation-minimal for the common case of small context maps. No global mutable state introduced.

PrincipalType wire format enforces Cedar PascalCase names; snake_case values are rejected at deserialization preventing silent entity-type mismatch attacks. principal_id is Option<String> — anonymous/system requests do not require sentinel values that could be spoofed. All fields are validated at the boundary; no exec paths from context values.

AuthzDecision exposes three named constructors (allow/default_deny/explicit_deny) and is_allowed() predicate to reduce call-site boilerplate. EvalLogFilter::default() yields limit=100 matching the serde default, so callers that omit limit get the documented behavior without surprises.

AuthzRequest encodes all Cedar evaluation inputs: tenant_id, principal_type (PrincipalType enum with cedar str mapping), principal_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, context BTreeMap. AuthzDecision carries effect (re-uses PolicyEffect), determining_policies, errors. EvalLogFilter provides query filter with serde-defaulted limit=100. Convenience constructors allow/default_deny/explicit_deny on AuthzDecision reduce call-site boilerplate. All types derive Serialize/Deserialize for gRPC/HTTP transport readiness. PolicyEffect uses UPPERCASE wire values for unambiguous serialization.

Alternative considered: derive serde on all types using snake_case. Rejected because PrincipalType variant names match Cedar entity-type strings exactly (PascalCase); using snake_case would require remapping at every adapter boundary and contradict as_cedar_str(). Alternative considered: separate DTO structs for wire layer. Rejected as premature — the kernel types are the wire contract for this slice; a dedicated DTO layer is appropriate only when the gRPC adapter crate is scaffolded in a later P14 delta.

No cryptographic material in any field. PrincipalType deserialization rejects unknown variants by default (serde derive), preventing privilege escalation via forged principal types. EvalLogFilter.limit is u32 — no negative-value denial-of-service vector. No unsafe code introduced.

No raw secret material in module or tests. principal_id kept Option<String> to support anonymous/system requests without sentinel values. BTreeMap for context provides deterministic serialization order.

Audit-chain row appended with distinct timestamp_unix + session_id. References F-M02B-PLAN-LIVE-CRATE-RECONCILIATION cross-phase tracker consistent with P02/P03/P04/P05/P06 prior merge-variant deltas.
